slides.0.title: Sweet wines and the Prädikat law
slides.0.subtitle: The § 11 Weingesetz thresholds
slides.1.title: Sugar thresholds (KMW)
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Spätlese and Auslese
slides.1.highlights.0.content: Spätlese at least 19 KMW (fully ripe grapes); Auslese at least 21 KMW (selected, with unripe and diseased berries removed)
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Beerenauslese
slides.1.highlights.1.content: At least 25 KMW, from overripe or noble-rotted berries
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Trockenbeerenauslese
slides.1.highlights.2.content: At least 30 KMW, from mostly noble-rotted and largely shrivelled berries; volatile acidity capped at 2.4 g/L
slides.1.highlights.3.title: General conditions
slides.1.highlights.3.content: Prädikatswein may be neither sweetened nor enriched; residual sugar may only come from interrupted fermentation
slides.1.content: KMW ladder: 19 → 21 → 25 → 30, going by the statute.
slides.2.title: Eiswein, Strohwein and Ausbruch
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Eiswein
slides.2.highlights.0.content: At least 25 KMW, with grapes frozen during harvest and pressing; may not carry another Prädikat name or be blended with other Prädikatsweine
slides.2.highlights.1.title: Strohwein / Schilfwein
slides.2.highlights.1.content: At least 25 KMW; ripe berries stored on straw, reed or hung for at least three months before pressing (earlier pressing is allowed if 30 KMW is reached after at least two months)
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Ausbruch
slides.2.highlights.2.content: In the statute it is not a separate category: a wine that meets the Trockenbeerenauslese conditions and comes from Rust may be labelled Ruster Ausbruch, and no other wine may use the word Ausbruch
slides.2.content: This also explains why Ausbruch thresholds varied by source in Level 2: it rests on the TBA conditions.
slides.3.title: Submission timing
slides.3.highlights.0.title: Spätlese and Auslese
slides.3.highlights.0.content: May not be submitted for the state test number before 1 January of the year after harvest
slides.3.highlights.1.title: Other Prädikatsweine
slides.3.highlights.1.content: May not be submitted before 1 April of that year
slides.3.content: These dates come from the statute and are a favourite Diploma detail.
What is the minimum KMW for Beerenauslese?
BA is at least 25 KMW; TBA is 30.
What is Ruster Ausbruch's status in the statute?
B. A Rust wine meeting the TBA conditions may carry the name
C. Any noble-rot wine may use it
Ausbruch rests on TBA conditions and is limited to Rust.
How long must Strohwein grapes normally be dried?
Normally at least three months (earlier if 30 KMW is reached after two).
